title: Recursive subsequence from a sequence
statement: Given a sequence $\mathrm{next}:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, define a sequence recursively by $a_0=\mathrm{next}(0)$ and $a_{k+1}=\mathrm{next}(a_k+1)$ for every $k\in\mathbb N$.
